messages:
Nina: Quick postmortem follow-up from this morning's capacity flash. Leaving a short action log so owners have a single place to check. Root cause: unexpectedly high queued batch jobs + autoscaler cooldowns too long.
Sam: Thanks. Can we list concrete remediation steps + owners and timelines? I can take scheduler tuning if needed.
Nina: Proposed actions: 
A) Scheduler knobs: reduce batch node eviction timeout, adjust binpack weight for small jobs (INC-3987). Owner: Sam. ETA: validate in staging by 48h.
B) Quota surge window: request temporary +25% GPUs for peak 48h while we validate autoscale changes (CAP-4501). Owner: Carmen. ETA: submit request today, follow up with cloud-billing.
C) Autoscaler tuning: lower scale-down grace to 20s, set min-ready-headroom to 12% and add cpu/gpu-queue length rules. Owner: Priya. ETA: perf test in 24h.
D) Runbook addendum: add exact triage steps, commands, and slack escalation steps. Owner: Nina. ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.
E) Incident pattern tracking: add recurring metric (surge-rate per-hour) and a weekly dashboard. Owner: Ops (shared). ETA: dashboard draft next week.
Priya: I'll own C. Plan is to run a canary in staging and synthetic traffic ramp. Will post k8s patch and perf numbers.
Sam: For A, I'll prototype the scheduler policy change; note we should also update pod priority class for batch vs realtime.
Carmen: I'll open CAP-4501 and include a justification + expected cost delta. Will request provisional quota and mark urgency as high. @ops-bot can you create a task?
ops-bot: Task created: CAP-4501 (provisional GPU quota request). Linked to INC-3987. Reminder: approve provisional quota only for 48h window.
Nina: Snippets for runbook (paste-friendly):
```
# temporarily raise batch replicas
kubectl scale deployment gpu-batcher -n inference --replicas=40
# adjust autoscaler configmap
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"scaleDownGrace":"20s","minHeadroom":"0.12"}}'
# quick check: queue length
kubectl get --raw "/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/inference/pods" | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, gpu: .containers[].usage.gpu }'
```
Sam: Noted. I'll add a scheduler unit test and a performance gate so changes don't regress tail latency.
Priya: Early staging runs show 10-15% fewer preemptions with lower grace; I'm uploading graphs to the incident board.
Carmen: CAP-4501 submitted: https://infra.company/tickets/CAP-4501 
Marked as provisional request with 48h window. Waiting on billing signoff.
Nina: Owners recap: Sam (scheduler), Priya (autoscaler), Carmen (quota), Nina (runbook + coordination). Meeting to review results tomorrow 09:30 PT. Weekly sync for next 3 weeks after closure to track recurrences.
ops-bot: Calendar invite: GPU-capacity-followup 2025-09-10 09:30 PT. Attendees: Nina, Sam, Priya, Carmen.
Sam: Adding tasks to sprint board (infra-priority). Will link scheduler PR once tests pass.
Priya: Will add synthetic workload script to the runbook PR for reproducibility.
Nina: Thanks all. If any owner needs to hand off, ping here and assign a backup. We'll close the follow-up when: CAP-4501 approved OR autoscaler changes reduce surge incidents by >=50% for two weeks.
Carmen: :thumbsup:
